title: Rory and the Silver Blossom Hill
verses:
The sun drifted down past the edge of the world,
And painted the valley in blue,
While Rory led softly along the green trail,
Through sparkles of evening dew.

High over the treetops came Nia in flight,
To glide on the whispers of air,
As Benny walked slowly behind with a hum,
Without any worry or care.

Up high on the crest of a velvety knoll,
The silver buds opened to gleam,
And Ricky tiptoed through the blossoms with joy,
Like figures that dance in a dream.

Then Tilly stepped over to gather the moss,
To cushion a circular space,
While Psittaco chirped from a perch on her horn,
To welcome their slumbering place.

And Rory curled down in the center of all,
To breathe with a velvety sigh,
While stars blinked like lanterns of silver and gold,
Across the wide hush of the sky.

The cool evening breeze sang a lullaby sweet,
To carry their worries away,
And tucked in together, the dinosaurs slept,
Until the bright dawn of the day.
